body:
Settled while building the overlay, and it corrects one promise d-install and d-wrapper both make: that after shadowing, the raw binary is still addressable at ${pkgs.zmx}/bin/zmx. That cannot hold. If the overlay installs the wrapper as `zmx`, then ${pkgs.zmx} *is* the wrapper.

So the overlay keeps the binary under the nixpkgs name for a shadowed package:

  zmx            the wrapper — what callers get
  zmx-unwrapped  the binary — prev.zmx, unforked, upgradeable

The escape hatches are unchanged in number and kind, only in spelling: ${pkgs.zmx-unwrapped}/bin/zmx, ZMX_RAW=1, ZMX_LAUNCHER. This refines d-install and d-wrapper without changing what they decided; the rest of both stands.
title: Shadow zmx and keep the binary as zmx-unwrapped
